items.title: Costs
items.summary: Streamline Asanda's spending onto trackable rails.
details: Food spending → ShopRite gift cards
Transport spending → Uber
Taxis → petty cash
Meds → Clicks pharmacy gift card or his Momentum debit account
Uber gift cards: Codashop — takes card payments directly (not just crypto), instant delivery, no registration
ShopRite gift cards: Bitrefill — buy with a US card via their card-to-crypto onramp, instant email delivery, carries plain + XtraSavings Shoprite cards

Clicks gift cards: no online purchase path found (in-store only in SA, not on Bitrefill/Codashop) — either have a local contact (Karl, Muneez, Wewe) buy in-store and reimburse, or skip the gift card and route meds through the Momentum HealthSaver debit card instead (see Momentum plan)
items.notes: Note: the 'ShopRite' coupon codes you'll find under simplycodes.com etc. are the unrelated US grocery chain — ignore those, they're not South Africa's Shoprite.

items.title: Story
items.summary: Write down Asanda's story for a future fundraiser or profile.
details: Record the conversation in Xhosa — phone voice memo is fine; a small handheld recorder (e.g. Zoom H1n) helps if it's noisy
Translate with TransWord.ai or Kapwing — both handle Xhosa audio directly, split it into timestamped segments, give an editable transcript + English translation
Have a human Xhosa speaker review the AI draft before it's used publicly — machine translation tends to flatten emotional register, and this is for a fundraiser
items.notes: No purchase strictly required — both translation tools are free/low-cost web tools.

items.title: Momentum plan
items.summary: Visit the Momentum office to sort Asanda's medical aid tier going forward.
details: Work out how to make annual payments
Discuss getting a social worker involved

Custom Option = hospital-only, no day-to-day account. Incentive Option = hospital + a day-to-day savings account (10% of contribution auto-allocated) — probably the better structural fit given we're currently hand-routing his food/transport/meds spending, but confirm the premium difference in person

The 'Momentum debit account' = HealthSaver — a linked savings account/card, debits at approved providers including pharmacies (Clicks qualifies), min R100/month via debit order, unused balance rolls over

Social worker isn't a standalone benefit — it's bundled into the medical rehabilitation benefit (private nursing, hospice, step-down care), approved case-by-case. Ask directly whether Asanda's situation qualifies

Ask whether his transplant follow-up care is protected as a Prescribed Minimum Benefit regardless of plan option — South African schemes are legally required to cover PMBs on every plan, which could mean the Custom/Incentive choice matters less for his core care and more for day-to-day cash flow
Also ask about the mental health benefit (covers a defined list of diagnoses — relevant given the therapist visit already planned) and Multiply rewards (discounts for health check participation)
items.notes: Researched Aug 2026 from Momentum's public plan pages — confirm current numbers in person, they change year to year.
